title: Jeff Wu
text: Welcome to my website! Here, I share online appendices for my publications and preprints, along with a portfolio of non-peer-reviewed works from my academic, professional, and personal endeavours — pieces that might not fit the current publishing outlets. You’ll also find links to my LinkedIn, Google Scholar, and GitHub.

title: Software
text: writeLog is an R package (available on CRAN) for logging interim results in data and analytical pipelines. Its writeLog() function saves results to versioned text files, so users can track how results change across long pipelines when code or data change. This helps with debugging, experimentation and testing.
